provenance: Original SVG geometry; accepted setar, Hammond organ and conga used as family references. No copied/traced artwork, embedded photos, logos or fonts.

structural_references.use: Sitar construction: long fretted neck, main and sympathetic strings, gourd and upper resonator. Museum photograph visually inspected in browser; not copied.
National Music Museum: four strings, no frets; corroborated by V&A tambura description.
Four open drone strings; tanpura identity distinct from fretted melody lute.
Manufacturer keyboard, back bellows and front stops; text and instrument photo visually inspected.
Bayan metal/pottery and offset syahi versus smaller wooden dahini/dayan. Sarangi skin resonator, three main strings and sympathetic strings.
Indian sarangi short neck, skin soundboard, main/sympathetic peg banks and bowed technique. Museum photograph visually inspected; not copied.

reviews.blind_recognition: Creator knew the subjects; unlabeled native panels were inspected in a distinct critique, not an independent recognition study.

issues.observation: First draft simplified the main string/peg layout too far.
issues.revision: Added seven main string runs and seven main pegs, distinct from the sympathetic peg bank.

limitations: Seven main strings/pegs, fretted neck and upper resonator checked. Sympathetic peg and fret counts are reduced for pictogram legibility; individual wires merge at 16px. Acoustic gourd sitar, not a solid-body zitar.

reviews.blind_recognition: Creator knew the subjects; unlabeled native panels were inspected in a distinct critique, not an independent recognition study.
limitations: Fretless neck, four strings/pegs and large rounded body checked. At 16px shares the broad lute family with sitar/setar; plain neck, four pegs and absence of an upper resonator distinguish the larger render.

reviews.blind_recognition: Creator knew the subjects; unlabeled native panels were inspected in a distinct critique, not an independent recognition study.

issues.observation: First draft keys read vertically against the wooden case.
issues.revision: Projected white/black keys onto a sloping top plane continuous with the case perspective.

limitations: Keyboard plane, black-key groups, stop knobs, rear bellows and body perspective checked against manufacturer layout. Key/stop counts are abstracted; exact reed configuration and model are not claimed.

limitations: Larger metal bayan with offset syahi and smaller wooden dayan with centered syahi, lacing and tuning blocks checked. Fine leather straps simplify at 16px; no sticks, generic skin drums or identical drum bodies.

reviews.blind_recognition: Creator knew the subjects; unlabeled native panels were inspected in a distinct critique, not an independent recognition study.
limitations: Short broad unfretted neck, three melody strings/main pegs, sympathetic-peg bank, pale skin-covered waisted lower body, bridge and separate bow checked against museum reference. Sympathetic strings/pegs are abbreviated; not Nepalese sarangi, sarod or violin.
